blurb: Whispering Springs Golf Course has a selection of indoor and outdoor spaces to host all your wedding events. They have a full-service golf facility in their downstairs and a year-round banquet hall in their upstairs. The foyer is an open space with a sitting area and large stone fireplace. The Ballroom is a large space with more than 3,000 square feet.
